(async()=>{const CK=(await import('/js/flight/cockpit.js')).CK, THREE=await import('three'); const ray=new THREE.Raycaster(), meshes=[]; CK.model.traverse(o=>{if(o.isMesh&&o.visible&&!(CK.glass||[]).includes(o)) meshes.push(o)}); CK.group.updateMatrixWorld(true); const inv=CK.group.matrixWorld.clone().invert(); const cast=(o,d)=>{ray.set(CK.group.localToWorld(o.clone()), d.clone().transformDirection(CK.group.matrixWorld)); ray.far=2; const h=ray.intersectObjects(meshes,false)[0]; if(!h) return null; const p=h.point.clone().applyMatrix4(inv); const n=h.face.normal.clone().transformDirection(h.object.matrixWorld).transformDirection(inv); return [+p.z.toFixed(2), +n.y.toFixed(1), +n.z.toFixed(1), (h.object.name||'').slice(0,14)]}; const fw={}; for (let x=-0.6;x<=0.31;x+=0.15) for (let y=0.2;y>=-0.41;y-=0.05) fw[x.toFixed(2)+','+y.toFixed(2)]=cast(new THREE.Vector3(x,y,0), new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1)); return JSON.stringify(fw)})()
